import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Create the dataset
data = {
    'survived': [0, 1, 1, 1, 0],
    'pclass': [3, 1, 3, 1, 3],
    'sex': ['male', 'female', 'female', 'female', 'male'],
    'age': [22.0, 38.0, 26.0, 35.0, 35.0],
    'sibsp': [1, 1, 0, 1, 0],
    'parch': [0, 0, 0, 0, 0],
    'fare': [7.25, 71.2833, 7.925, 53.1, 8.05],
    'embarked': ['S', 'C', 'S', 'S', 'S'],
    'class': ['Third', 'First', 'Third', 'First', 'Third'],
    'who': ['man', 'woman', 'woman', 'woman', 'man'],
    'adult_male': [True, False, False, False, True],
    'deck': [np.nan, 'C', np.nan, 'C', np.nan],
    'embark_town': ['Southampton', 'Cherbourg', 'Southampton', 'Southampton', 'Southampton'],
    'alive': ['no', 'yes', 'yes', 'yes', 'no'],
    'alone': [False, False, True, False, True]
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Set up the visualization
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(15, 10))
fig.suptitle('Titanic Passenger Data Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# 1. Survival by class and sex
survival_pivot = df.pivot_table(index='class', columns='sex', values='survived', aggfunc='mean')
survival_pivot.plot(kind='bar', ax=axes[0,0], color=['lightcoral', 'lightblue'])
axes[0,0].set_title('Survival Rate by Class and Sex')
axes[0,0].set_ylabel('Survival Rate')
axes[0,0].set_xlabel('Class')
axes[0,0].legend(title='Sex')
axes[0,0].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 2. Age distribution by survival
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='alive', y='age', ax=axes[0,1], palette='Set2')
axes[0,1].set_title('Age Distribution by Survival Status')
axes[0,1].set_xlabel('Survived')
axes[0,1].set_ylabel('Age')

# 3. Fare distribution by class
sns.violinplot(data=df, x='class', y='fare', ax=axes[0,2], palette='viridis')
axes[0,2].set_title('Fare Distribution by Class')
axes[0,2].set_xlabel('Class')
axes[0,2].set_ylabel('Fare')

# 4. Survival by embarkation port
embark_survival = df.groupby('embark_town')['survived'].mean()
axes[1,0].bar(embark_survival.index, embark_survival.values, color=['skyblue', 'lightgreen', 'salmon'])
axes[1,0].set_title('Survival Rate by Embarkation Port')
axes[1,0].set_ylabel('Survival Rate')
axes[1,0].set_xlabel('Embarkation Port')
axes[1,0].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 5. Family size vs survival
df['family_size'] = df['sibsp'] + df['parch'] + 1
family_survival = df.groupby('family_size')['survived'].mean()
axes[1,1].plot(family_survival.index, family_survival.values, marker='o', linestyle='-', color='purple')
axes[1,1].set_title('Survival Rate by Family Size')
axes[1,1].set_xlabel('Family Size')
axes[1,1].set_ylabel('Survival Rate')
axes[1,1].set_xticks(range(1, max(family_survival.index) + 1))

# 6. Alone status vs survival
alone_survival = df.groupby('alone')['survived'].mean()
axes[1,2].bar(['With Family', 'Alone'], alone_survival.values, color=['lightblue', 'lightcoral'])
axes[1,2].set_title('Survival Rate by Alone Status')
axes[1,2].set_ylabel('Survival Rate')
axes[1,2].set_xlabel('')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
